justification: A is a flat, two-column grid of dense rectangular glyph blocks read in ordered rows, while B is a three-dimensional crouching creature-like figure with a large mass above its head; the only overlap is the general use of rounded, incised, cartouche-like forms and the presence of eyes/faces. There is no shared scene, no shared relationship between elements, and no comparable arrangement — one is an ordered script-like matrix, the other a single sculptural figure.
